sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Google Ads Management Company Kochi

items.q: How much should I budget for Google Ads?
items.a: Budget depends on your industry, competition, and goals — we'll recommend a realistic starting budget after reviewing your market and target keywords during account setup or audit.

items.q: How is this different from SEO?
items.a: Google Ads delivers immediate visibility through paid placements, while SEO builds organic rankings over months. Most businesses benefit from both, with Google Ads campaign setup services handling immediate needs while SEO builds long-term traffic.

items.q: Do you set up conversion tracking?
items.a: Yes. Conversion tracking setup services are configured before any significant spend begins, since optimization without accurate tracking is essentially guesswork.

items.q: Can you audit our existing Google Ads account?
items.a: Yes. A Google Ads audit Kochi reviews your current campaigns for wasted spend, tracking issues, and missed opportunities, with a clear report on what to fix.

items.q: What's the difference between Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns?
items.a: Search ads target people actively searching specific terms. Shopping ads showcase products directly. Performance max campaign management uses Google's automation across all networks simultaneously, useful once you have enough conversion data to feed the algorithm.

items.q: How often do you review and adjust campaigns?
items.a: Weekly, at minimum. Google Ads budget optimization requires frequent adjustment — bids, budgets, and targeting all shift based on what's converting, and waiting a full month between reviews often means wasted spend goes unnoticed too long.
